To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
ALK1 achieves its high specificity for BMP 9/10 through an unusual receptor positioning and a unique receptor ligand binding interface.
the high specificity and high affinity of ALK1 is determined by a unique set of ALK1 receptor ligand interactions that are mediated by an unusual ALK1 positioning relative to BMP9.

the ALK1 BMP signaling pathway is a highly selective pathway for BMP9/ 10 and is achieved by an unusual receptor positioning and novel receptor ligand interface that is distinct from other TGF b family signaling pathways.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the biophysical and biochemical properties of the endothelial cell specific receptor ALK1, a type I TGF b super family receptor.
understanding the molecular basis of the signaling pathways of the TGFb superfamily of ligands.
understanding how a protein receptor recognizes its ligand.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

we have determined the structure of a fully active ALK1 BMP receptor signaling complex and have used a combination of structural and biophysical approaches to elucidate the mechanism of ALK1 signaling, which is a key step towards the development of novel anti angiogenic therapeutics.
ALK1 achieves a high specificity for BMP 9 and 10 by a novel positioning of ALK1 in the ternary complex and by unique interactions between the receptor and its ligands.
the high affinity of ALK1 signaling complex is determined by a unique set of interactions between BMP9, ALK1 and ACTRIIB.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have determined the crystal structure of an assembled ALK1 signaling complex and have provided kinetic and thermodynamic data on receptor ligand interactions in the ALK1 pathway.
we have determined that BMP9/10 have evolved to specifically interact with ALK1.
we have determined the structure of the ALK signaling complex and that the structure explains the mechanism for how the ALK receptor achieves high specificity for its ligands.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ALK1 achieves its specificity through a novel orientation of the receptor with respect to the ligand, which results in unique ligand receptor interactions.
ALK1 is a high specificity BMP receptor that achieves this specificity by adopting a unique orientation with respect to BMP ligands and by forming a unique receptor ligand binding interface.
ALK1 has a very high specificity for BMP 9 and BMP 10 and that this specificity is determined by an atypical orientation of BMP ligands relative to ALK1.
